columns.name: sequence
columns.description: Epitope residues, upper case, with no modification suffix or hybrid junction

columns.name: peptide_length
columns.description: Number of residues in the sequence

columns.name: iedb_epitope_id
columns.description: IEDB epitope accession; one sequence can carry several

columns.name: mhc_allele
columns.description: MHC restriction as reported, which may be an allele or a class

columns.name: allele_is_specific
columns.description: Whether mhc_allele names an allele rather than a class such as 'HLA class I'

columns.name: uniprot_id
columns.description: UniProt accession of the source protein, where IEDB records one

columns.name: source_molecule
columns.description: Name of the originating protein, as most commonly reported for the group

columns.name: start_position
columns.description: Start of the epitope in the source protein, most commonly reported value

columns.name: end_position
columns.description: End of the epitope in the source protein, paired with start_position

columns.name: pmids
columns.description: PubMed IDs of every publication behind the group

columns.name: n_pmids
columns.description: Number of distinct publications behind the group

columns.name: is_modified
columns.description: Whether any assay in the group reported a post-translational modification

columns.name: modifications
columns.description: Modifications reported for the group, such as Oxidation or Deamidation

columns.name: modified_residues
columns.description: Residues carrying those modifications, such as M22

columns.name: n_assays
columns.description: Number of rows in the full export behind this one
